title: Description marks
description: docs/descriptions.json: marks on the explanatory layer (PRD §8, DC-5). The texts stay in their objects' own `description` fields (project.json, model tables, measures, datasets, reports, ML models); a mark says who wrote the text (`agent` = drafted by the Documenter, unreviewed; `human` = written or reviewed by a person) and holds SHA-256 hashes of the text and of the object's definition when it was marked. A changed definition hash flags the text "may be outdated"; a changed text hash voids the mark.
